claims.claim: In fasted humans, SRT2104, a thiazole-containing high-molecular-weight oral drug, had absolute oral bioavailability of 13.8% (range 2–27%) after a 0.25 g oral suspension with an IV microdose reference, below the 20% threshold.

Multiple reference peptidomimetic/large lipophilic oral drugs have human absolute oral F below 20%: revefenacin <3%, lopinavir poor/very low, alvimopan 6%, octreotide 0.3–0.6%, GHRP-6 ~0.3%, renin inhibitors <2%, and cromolyn ~1%.
